regions.name: Sebuku River
regions.quote: In Sabah it's been recorded at various localities including Bettotan, Sandokan, Kinabatangan, Lahad Datu, Tawau, Kudat, and Bongon, while in Kalimantan Timur it's known only from the Sebuku River basin.

regions.name: Borneo
regions.quote: Betta ocellata was described in 1933 and is native to Sabah in northeastern Borneo and the far north of Kalimantan, where published records come from the Sebuku River basin.
